<p>下面介绍上述四种场景的扩容方案</p>
<h3 id="54231317_二、扩容方案-扩容5g">二、扩容方案-扩容5G</h3>
<h4 id="54231317_2.1-场景1，有分区，有lvm">2.1 场景1，有分区，有LVM</h4>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-23a7f223.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<h5 id="54231317_方法一、增大原磁盘空间">方法一、增大原磁盘空间</h5>
<p>1.将硬盘空间扩大5GB<br>
2.刷新硬盘</p>
<pre><code>echo 1 &gt; /sys/class/scsi_device/0\:0\:0\:0/device/rescan
或
echo 1 &gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;/sys/class/block/sda/device/rescan
或
echo '- - -' &gt; /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/scan</code></pre>
<p>3.对硬盘进行分区</p>
<pre><code>fdisk /dev/sda</code></pre>
<p>分别按下：<code>n</code>（新建分区）-》<code>p</code>（选择主分区）-》<code>3</code>（设置分区号）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认起始扇区）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认last扇区）-》<code>t</code>（设置磁盘标志符）-》<code>3</code>（选择分区3）-》<code>8e</code>（将标识符改为8e-LVM）-》<code>w</code>（保存分区表）</p>
<p>4.刷新分区表</p>
<pre><code>partprobe /dev/sda</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-9d217020.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>5.创建pv</p>
<pre><code>pvcreate /dev/sda3</code></pre>
<p>6.扩容vg</p>
<pre><code>vgextend centos /dev/sda3</code></pre>
<p>7.扩容lv</p>
<pre><code># 将剩余的空间100%全部给lv扩容
lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/mapper/centos-root
或者
# 将lv额外增加5G空间
lvextend -L +5G /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若提示<code>Insufficient free space: 1280 extents needed, but only 1279 available</code>,将100%或者5G数字改小一些即可</p>
</blockquote>
<p>8.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-deaf9eea.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>成功！</p>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：使用扩大本磁盘容量的方式扩容LVM，若lvm所在的分区在磁盘的最后，可以通过<code>parted</code>命令扩大分区之后扩容lvm，反之建议直接新建分区进行扩容。</p>
<p>若磁盘比较多，无法定位哪块盘的情况下，执行<code>/dev/disk/by-path</code>命令查看<code>scsi</code>号</p>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="54231317_方法二、添加一块新硬盘">方法二、添加一块新硬盘</h5>
<p>1.在虚机设置中新增一块5G硬盘</p>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-d99ad9e4.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
2.对新硬盘进行分区</p>
<pre><code>fdisk /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<p>分别按下：<code>n</code>（新建分区）-》<code>p</code>（选择主分区）-》<code>1</code>（设置分区号）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认起始扇区）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认last扇区）-》<code>t</code>（设置磁盘标志符）-》<code>1</code>（选择分区3）-》<code>8e</code>（将标识符改为8e-LVM）-》<code>w</code>（保存分区表）</p>
<p>3.刷新分区表</p>
<pre><code>partprobe /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-9d217020.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>4.创建pv</p>
<pre><code>pvcreate /dev/sdb1</code></pre>
<p>5.扩容vg</p>
<pre><code>vgextend centos /dev/sdb1</code></pre>
<p>6.扩容lv</p>
<pre><code># 将剩余的空间100%全部给lv扩容
lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/mapper/centos-root
或者
# 将lv额外增加5G空间
lvextend -L +5G /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若提示<code>Insufficient free space: 1280 extents needed, but only 1279 available</code>,将100%或者5G数字改小一些即可</p>
</blockquote>
<p>7.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-cfb6a8ac.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>成功！</p>
<h4 id="54231317_2.1-场景2，有分区，无lvm">2.1 场景2，有分区，无LVM</h4>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-b6803119.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
1.将原硬盘容量直接扩大5GB<br>
2.刷新磁盘</p>
<pre><code>echo 1 &gt; /sys/class/scsi_disk/2\:0\:1\:0/device/rescan</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-d87d271b.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
3.删除分区，重新新建分区</p>
<pre><code>fdisk /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<p>分别按下：<code>d</code>（删除分区）-》<code>n</code>（新建分区）-》<code>p</code>（选择主分区）-》<code>1</code>（设置分区号）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认起始扇区）-》<code>回车</code>（使用默认last扇区）-》<code>w</code>（保存分区表）</p>
<blockquote>
<p>删除分区的方式非常危险，为避免异常情况，建议使用<code>parted /dev/sdb resizepart x 100%</code>进行分区扩容(x代表分区序号，可以通过parted /dev/sdb&nbsp;&nbsp;print命令查看，如果提示需要修复gpt，选择fix,这种方式也适用于有分区，有lvm而且没有swap分区的情况)</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code>[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:31:32] # parted /dev/vda print
Warning: Not all of the space available to /dev/vda appears to be used, you can fix the GPT to use all of the space (an extra 83886080 blocks) or continue with the current setting? 
Fix/Ignore? Fix&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
Model: Virtio Block Device (virtblk)
Disk /dev/vda: 107GB
Sector size (logical/physical): 512B/512B
Partition Table: gpt
Disk Flags: 

Number&nbsp;&nbsp;Start&nbsp; &nbsp;End&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Size&nbsp; &nbsp; File system&nbsp;&nbsp;Name&nbsp;&nbsp;Flags
 1&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;1049kB&nbsp;&nbsp;2097kB&nbsp;&nbsp;1049kB&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;bios_grub
 2&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;2097kB&nbsp;&nbsp;2150MB&nbsp;&nbsp;2147MB&nbsp;&nbsp;ext4

[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:32:47] # parted /dev/vda resizepart 3 100%
Information: You may need to update /etc/fstab.

[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:33:04] # pvs&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 
&nbsp;&nbsp;PV&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;VG&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Fmt&nbsp;&nbsp;Attr PSize&nbsp; &nbsp;PFree
&nbsp;&nbsp;/dev/vda3&nbsp;&nbsp;ubuntu lvm2 a--&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;58.00g&nbsp; &nbsp; 0 
[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:33:06] # pvresize /dev/vda3

&nbsp;&nbsp;1 physical volume(s) resized or updated / 0 physical volume(s) not resized
[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:33:10] # lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/ubuntu/root
&nbsp;&nbsp;Size of logical volume ubuntu/root changed from &lt;58.00 GiB (14847 extents) to &lt;98.00 GiB (25087 extents).
&nbsp;&nbsp;Logical volume ubuntu/root successfully resized.
[root@k8s-master-02:~ 10:33:20] # xfs_growfs /dev/ubuntu/root

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;=&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sunit=0&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;swidth=0 blks

log&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;=internal log&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bsize=4096&nbsp; &nbsp;blocks=6911, version=2

/dev/mapper/ubuntu-root&nbsp; &nbsp;98G&nbsp; &nbsp;17G&nbsp; &nbsp;82G&nbsp;&nbsp;18% /</code></pre>
<p>4.刷新分区表</p>
<pre><code>partprobe /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-c16bceec.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
5.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/sdb1</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/sdb1</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-a5aac0fd.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
成功！</p>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若一块硬盘有多个分区，则只能对最后一个分区进行扩容操作，中间分区不建议扩容，风险太大。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="54231317_2.1-场景3，无分区，有lvm">2.1 场景3，无分区，有LVM</h4>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-1fecb1ed.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<h5 id="54231317_方法一、增大原磁盘空间-1">方法一、增大原磁盘空间</h5>
<p>1.将原磁盘空间扩大5GB<br>
2.刷新磁盘</p>
<pre><code>echo 1 &gt; /sys/class/scsi_disk/2\:0\:1\:0/device/rescan</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-ef0ffb1e.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
3.刷新pv</p>
<pre><code>pvresize /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-3b6aeaf8.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
4.扩容lv</p>
<pre><code># 将剩余的空间100%全部给lv扩容
lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/mapper/data-backup
或者
# 将lv额外增加5G空间
lvextend -L +5G /dev/mapper/data-backup</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若提示<code>Insufficient free space: 1280 extents needed, but only 1279 available</code>,将100%或者5G数字改小一些即可</p>
</blockquote>
<p>5.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/mapper/data-backup</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/mapper/data-backup</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-1707cc90.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>成功!</p>
<blockquote>
<p>若磁盘比较多，无法定位哪块盘的情况下，执行<code>/dev/disk/by-path</code>命令查看<code>scsi</code>号</p>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="54231317_方法二、添加一块新硬盘-1">方法二、添加一块新硬盘</h5>
<p>1.添加一块5G的硬盘</p>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-f8169eaa.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
2.创建pv</p>
<pre><code>pvcreate /dev/sdc</code></pre>
<p>3.扩容vg</p>
<pre><code>vgextend data /dev/sdc</code></pre>
<p>4.扩容lv</p>
<pre><code># 将剩余的空间100%全部给lv扩容
lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/mapper/data-backup
或者
# 将lv额外增加5G空间
lvextend -L +5G /dev/mapper/data-backup</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若提示<code>Insufficient free space: 1280 extents needed, but only 1279 available</code>,将100%或者5G数字改小一些即可</p>
</blockquote>
<p>5.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/mapper/data-backup</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/mapper/centos-root</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-1508a231.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
成功！</p>
<h4 id="54231317_2.1-场景4，无分区，无lvm">2.1 场景4，无分区，无LVM</h4>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-aaaf0265.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
1.将原磁盘容量增大5G<br>
2.刷新硬盘</p>
<pre><code>echo 1 &gt; /sys/class/scsi_device/0\:0\:0\:0/device/rescan
或
echo 1 &gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;/sys/class/block/sda/device/rescan
或
echo '- - -' &gt; /sys/class/scsi_host/host0/scan</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-a7bbea10.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<p>3.文件系统合并</p>
<pre><code>xfs_growfs /dev/sdb</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：若文件系统格式为<code>ext*</code>，则使用命令<code>resize2fs /dev/sdb</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://b3logfile.com/file/2020/06/image-4de5aafc.png" alt="image.png" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"><br>
成功！</p></div>
